verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own site claims that even a 2011 ThinkPad X220 with 2GB of RAM can run it "with room to spare," and it ships Foot as a fast, lightweight default terminal. A hands-on report confirms it runs well on a €30 N23 Chromebook with a 32GB SSD, though the ISO install failed there and the user fell back to archinstall. Critics also note a 7GB ISO bundled with extra apps, which tempers the lightweight story without contradicting the old-hardware claim. Missing for 10: benchmarks or evidence of better performance versus the prior OS, documented minimum hardware requirements, and a reliable ISO install path on low-end or older devices.
